name: Notify User of Created Work Items
script:
# Notify user of the number of work items successfully created via screen message

# Read workflow variables from the Processa engine
work_items_created = frappe.form_dict.get("work_items_created", [])

# Count the work items
work_item_count = len(work_items_created) if work_items_created else 0

# Build a friendly notification message
if work_item_count > 0:
    message = f"Success! {work_item_count} work item(s) have been created from this technical research."
else:
    message = "No work items were created from this technical research."

# Print message to screen and return for workflow
frappe.msgprint(message)

frappe.response["message"] = {
    "notification_displayed": True,
    "work_items_count": work_item_count,
    "message": message
}
